purpose: Document official city parcel-source evidence, bounded anonymous geometry route review, and remaining coverage/runtime limits.
assessment: Acapulco de Juárez municipal cadastre service evidence. Risk Atlas layers were not treated as parcel geometry.
registryAssessment: The official municipal portal identifies a Dirección de Catastro e Impuesto Predial and lists its local office/contact. The 2026 municipal revenue law describes prints of verified/cadastrally registered parcel locations through digital cartography and a separate planimetric restitution vector coverage for not-yet-verified urban parcels. This confirms municipal cadastral activity, not a public vector download.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official city page lists the Dirección de Catastro e Impuesto Predial and its downtown office/contact for balance questions and clarifications.

2026 municipal revenue law lists fees for printed locations of already verified/cadastrally registered urban parcels via digital cartography, plus a distinct planimetric restitution vector coverage for unverified parcels.
Guerrero municipal cadastral law establishes cadastral/parcel map registers and the fields that may be held in cadastral records; it is not a published city vector service.
Official interactive risk atlas contains hazard and planning layers with some parcel-related counts; it does not expose or establish a municipal cadastral parcel polygon layer.
